omg.sampler.cell_distributions.NormalCellDistribution#

class omg.sampler.cell_distributions.NormalCellDistribution(loc: float = 0.0, scale: float = 1.0)[source]#

Base distribution that samples entries of cell vectors from a normal distribution with given mean and standard deviation.

Parameters:

  • loc (float) – Mean of the normal distribution. Defaults to 0.0.

  • scale (float) – Standard deviation of the normal distribution. Defaults to 1.0.

Raises:

ValueError – If the scale is less than or equal to 0.
